list.title: Saray Rehistrasyon
list.empty: Anggapoy rehistrasyon ya mipara ed sarayan filter.

override.title: Admin Override
override.hint: Saray override et lanang ya aka-log ed admin identity tan rason mo - agbalot man-silent.
override.cancelBookingHint: Say kanselasyon et mankabaliksan ya kinansela so booking tan say komisyon to, ipawil so operational ownership ed partner, tan abuloyan so builder ya man-book lamet na sayan lead.
override.cancelBookingConfirm: Kanselaen mo yan booking? Kanselado met so komisyon to. Saya so akasulat ed ngaran tan rason mo.

detail.disputeOpen: Walay sangsangan nipaakar ed panagkayarian ed sayan kustomer - inkuan na sananey a kapareha ya kayarian da itan. Nadesisyonan itan ed pahina na Saray Panlalaban.

cancellation.title: Kanselado so booking
cancellation.hint: Kanselado so booking tan say komisyon to; say operational ownership et pinmawil ed partner tan say builder et nayarin man-book lamet na sayan lead.

disputes.title: Saray Panlalaban ed Panagkayarian
disputes.hint: Say partner ya say rehistrasyon to et ag-inawat bilang duplicate et nayarin mansuppiat no siopay akankayarian ed kustomer. Repasoen so duaran dapag tan mandesisyon.

detail.title: Pansasangsangan {{id}}
detail.heldMissing: Say akabemben ya rehistrasyon et ag aromog.
detail.upholdEffect: {{holder}} so mansiansia ed kustomer. Asumpal lay sangsangan tan anggapo lay arum ya manguman.
detail.overturnEffect: {{holder}} 's duplicate protection et manampot la natan tan say kustomer et akarehistro la parad {{partner}} bilang balon rehistrasyon.
detail.heldBookedHelp: Sayan kustomer et aka-book ed panamegley na kaplesan ya akankayarian. Kanselaen nin unona itan ya booking (Admin Override ed registration), insan i-overturn:
